items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Well, this is Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamer O'Calley. Born Mary Lucy Hamer in 1876 at Fixford, Mississippi.

ctx.x: First of all, this is being recorded in past Christian, April 4th, 1958. May the 4th, darling. May the 4th, 1958. Getting mixed up to start off with. Alright, now, first I'd like you to tell your name, your birthplace, your date, when you lived in New Orleans, and so on, and then we'll start off on the memories of jazz.

Well, this is Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamer O'Calley. Born Mary Lucy Hamer in 1876 at Fixford, Mississippi. He lived after my marriage in 1900 at Ashwood, Louisiana on the plantation that my husband owned. Came to New Orleans in 1909. Built a home there and lived in New Orleans until 1940. When I came to pass with jazz, to leave it, I was going home there. And I can't remember when.
